text: ねぼけた　こと　いってんじゃねえ　わかぞう！

patterns.name: 〜のではない
patterns.explanation: てんじゃねえ is a rough squeezed form of ているのではない, used to tell someone angrily to stop doing something. いってんじゃねえ = 'don't be saying that'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. ねぼけたこと = 'things said half-asleep', so 'nonsense'.
